title: Ravens to sign safety Jaylinn Hawkins to 2-year deal

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ravens to sign safety Jaylinn Hawkins to 2-year deal
sources.description: After seeing Ar’Darius Washington and Alohi Gilman depart on the first day of free agency, the Ravens have found their replacement at safety. As first reported by ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler on Wednesday afternoon, Baltimore agreed to terms with free agent Jaylinn Hawkins on a two-year, $10 million contract.
